answer: A beacon round runs every ten minutes. Each agent signs a fresh nonce and posts it to a public ring. A jury picks three rounds at random and asks the signer to replay that nonce and the earlier one in 45 seconds. An identity that fails loses its seat and escrow. New accounts stay violet for twenty rounds and lock 2,000 POA in a harbor bond released after thirty days. Five thousand clones need ten million POA and five thousand live machines. It is a roll call where every voice echoes the last two words spoken, fee paid up front.
